plugins.Author: Boxu
plugins.Name: Skippy
plugins.Punchline: Allows you to skip a lot of categories of cutscenes, including MSQ Roulette Dungeons & Trials, Inn Login Sequence, Ocean Fishing and more!
plugins.Description: Skip all of the Cutscenes that bother you (MSQ Roulette for example) so you can actually play the game!
plugins.Changelog:
Global: (Bugfix) Fixed Porta Decumana cutscene not skipping even with the right toggles on.
Global: (Bugfix) Hopefully properly fixed skip categories spilling over other categories and affecting their skipping abilities.
Logger: Enhanced the logging capabilities of Skippy for research purposes.
UI: Added a button to the topbar to toggle the Tester badge visibility on/off.
